Top candidates from the stem list: Purple_Leaf_Sheath, Physoderma_Brown_Spot, Anthracnose_Leaf_Spot_And_Top_Dieback, Physoderma_Stalk_Rot.

Let me view reference images one at a time, starting with the top candidates.
Purple_Leaf_Sheath reference shows discrete dark lesions on green stalks. The test image has more diffuse purple discoloration on dried tissue. Let me check Physoderma_Brown_Spot.
Physoderma_Brown_Spot shows dark purplish-black spots on green stalk tissue with some purple at the node. Some similarity with the dark specks in the test image. Let me check more candidates.
Anthracnose stem shows black lesions on dried stalks - different from the test image. Let me check Physoderma_Stalk_Rot.

Physoderma_Stalk_Rot shows dark brown/black spots clustered on a green stalk near the node. The spots are similar but the test image has much more diffuse purple coloring on dried tissue. Let me check more candidates. Let me look at the other Purple_Leaf_Sheath references and also Diplodia_Stalk_Rot and Charcoal_Stalk_Rot.

I've now seen 3 Purple_Leaf_Sheath references. The third one (Corn_Disease_6.jpg) shows extensive diffuse purple coloring on the sheath, which is the closest match so far to the test image. Let me use my last view on another class.

Charcoal_Stalk_Rot shows shredded internal pith with dark sclerotia. Completely different from the test image.

**Summary of analysis:**

The test image shows a corn leaf sheath with:
- Diffuse purple/pinkish discoloration spread across the tissue
- Tan/brown dried background
- Small dark specks scattered across the surface
- Visible vein lines running through the tissue

Comparing across all viewed references:
- **Purple_Leaf_Sheath** (Corn_Disease_6.jpg) was the best match, showing extensive diffuse purple coloring on the leaf sheath, which matches the broad purple discoloration pattern in the test image
- Physoderma_Brown_Spot has discrete dark spots but not the diffuse purple spread
- Anthracnose, Diplodia, Charcoal stalk rots all look distinctly different
- Physoderma_Stalk_Rot shows clustered dark spots at nodes, not diffuse purple

The KB description for Purple_Leaf_Sheath states "dark lesions on corn stalks and leaf collars, with color varying from purple to brown to black," which matches the test image's appearance.
